The '''Mythosaur axe''' was a weapon used by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], named after the extinct Mandalorian monster, the [[Mythosaur/Legends|Mythosaur]]. It was most notably used by [[Mandalore the Indomitable]].

==Description==
The axe was made of overlapping blades of calcified Mythosaur bone constructed on either side of the handle. The weapon was a ceremonial weapon but could be deadly if used in combat. [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] had a [[Mandalore the Ultimate's battle-axe|modernized version]] of a Mythosaur Axe forged from the scrap of the starship [[Courageous (Inexpugnable-class)|''Courageous'']]. The modern metals combined with an energy cell produced a greater damage capability.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Kuar.jpg|thumb|left]]On the [[Plains of Harkul]] on the Mandalorian world of [[Kuar]], [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] challenged [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] to a [[Duel on Kuar|duel]], inviting the Sith to put away his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and fight using only Mythosaur axes. Qel-Droma agreed to these terms, fought against Mandalore using the traditional weapon, and eventually defeated him. As a result, Mandalore pledged his loyalty to Qel-Droma, thereby allying the Mandalorian clans with the Sith, thus escalating the events of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi: The Sith War 1: Edge of the Whirlwind" />

It was noted in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Mandalorian splinter group, that ''[[Beskad/Legends|beskade]]'' and Mythosaur axes were the handheld weapons that [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] Crusaders primarily relied on. The document was supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the movement's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]], [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;although the Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] doubted its authenticity&mdash;and was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' by Jango's son, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
